title: Monitoring and Evaluation on Agricultural and Rural development Projects

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply project management principles to monitor and evaluate agricultural and rural development projects.
Collect and analyze data systematically to support decision-making in agricultural and rural development projects.
Use data analysis to support decision-making and policy evaluation in agricultural and rural development projects.
Work effectively in teams to monitor and evaluate agricultural and rural development projects.
Effectively communicate findings and recommendations from monitoring and evaluation activities.
Design and implement monitoring and evaluation systems for agricultural and rural development projects.
Evaluate policies and programs in agricultural and rural development using monitoring and evaluation techniques.
Write comprehensive reports on monitoring and evaluation findings for agricultural and rural development projects.

prerequisite_courses: Investment in Agricultural and Rural Development
